disclaimer: Simplified FEDERAL direct tax only (Direkte Bundessteuer), single filer. A flat CHF 2,600 approximation of the federal insurance-premium deduction is applied; the percentage-based professional-expense deduction is not separately modeled. Above CHF 176,000 the true federal formula caps the average rate in a way this bracket engine approximates as a flat continuation of the top marginal rate, which slightly overstates tax at very high incomes. Select a Canton below to add cantonal + (currently blended) communal tax on top.
